normal.text: Is gaming really just a social construct? LeRon argues that, like societies and civilizations, gaming is shaped by the narratives we build around it. normal.name: Jakob Fel
normal.text: "Since the English are infamous for having no taste where food is concerned, you shouldn't have too much of a problem conquering the city with your tasty pizzas." That is a real quote from Pizza Connection 2, a German managerial sim from 2001. It doesn't surprise me that German devs from the early 2000s didn't pull any punches :knuckleslol: #RetroGames #simulation #Poland #gog #pcgaming #PCMR

normal.name: Jakob Fel
normal.text: These days, GOG has an "additional contribution" option when purchasing anything. Today, I tried something new: I've decided that, going forward, I'll be rounding up all of my orders to the nearest whole dollar. I'm not buying much these days (for various reasons) but rounding up contributes a few cents each time. That's not a huge contribution but if we all started doing that to our orders, that still helps to support GOG's game preservation efforts over time. #gog #drmfree #RetroGames
